audit_items.proof_trace: Handler returns RpcErrorResponse::InvalidRequest for out-of-range requests, but Ethereum P2P spec mandates ResourceUnavailable (error code 3) for data outside serve range. InvalidRequest indicates malformed request, not unavailable data.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Remote peer requests data columns outside serve range, receives InvalidRequest instead of ResourceUnavailable, causing protocol confusion and potential peer scoring/reputation issues or sync failures.
